items.title: Centered multi-photo feed preview
items.precondition: Signed in on Feed; a standard post with 2–10 images is visible; isolated acceptance runtime is running.
steps: Open the feed at a desktop viewport at least 1024px wide.
Compare the gallery's left and right whitespace within the post content area.
Open the same feed at a narrow mobile viewport.
items.expected: The gallery's centerline matches the enclosing post card's centerline and it is no wider than 36rem on desktop; at narrow widths it fills the available content width without horizontal overflow; its grid, overlay count, and click-through behavior remain intact.

items.title: Multi-photo preview opens at the first detail photo
items.precondition: Signed in on Feed; a standard or shared post with at least two photos is visible; isolated acceptance runtime is running.
steps: Wait for the post detail page to load.
Observe the initial viewport and keyboard focus.
Open an explicit comment link for the same post.
items.expected: Preview navigation lands on the first photo at the #photos album anchor with no comment-composer focus; explicit #comments navigation still scrolls to comments and may autofocus the composer.

items.title: Single-photo feed post remains centered and functional
items.precondition: Signed in on Feed; a standard post with exactly one image is visible; isolated acceptance runtime is running.
steps: View the single-photo post at desktop width.
Confirm its image stage is centered and uses the same maximum width behavior.
items.expected: The single photo follows the same full-card-centered responsive stage and opens the post detail page normally.

items.title: Shared media consumers do not regress
items.precondition: A multi-photo post, its detail page, a profile-timeline rendering, and a shared-post embed are available in the isolated acceptance runtime.
steps: Open the post detail page from the feed preview.
View the same or another post in a profile timeline.
View a shared-post embed containing multiple photos.
items.expected: Post detail has no clipping or overflow; the entire shared-post embed and its original media are centered on the full feed card and use the normal feed-gallery proportions; profile timeline and compact share-composer preview retain their current sizing and controls.

items.title: Frontend build gate
steps: Run the repository typecheck/build command required by package scripts.
Run the impacted convention/lint checks if configured.
items.expected: No errors caused by the feature change; any pre-existing failures are documented separately.
items.evidence: 2026-08-06: After the Rev 12 photo-navigation revision, npm run typecheck and npm run build passed on kylie/photos-centered. npm --prefix frontend run lint completed with the same six pre-existing warnings in AuthContext.tsx, ThemeContext.tsx, MessageQuoteStrip.tsx, PostDetailPage.tsx, and PostPhotoCommentsPage.tsx; none are in the changed files.
items.notes: Visual UI items A1–A3 and A5 require the contained -tw runtime and remain pending.
